notes: Cindy plugins are installed per device from the marketplace; their folders and state live in the Cindy app data directory next to per-device secrets in safe-storage.
Never copy the plugin install folders between machines: install each id again in Cindy on the target machine, then authorize it there.
namespace null means the public marketplace; 'local' means a local development copy that has no marketplace release.
